entities.summary: William Pierce Rogers was an American politician, diplomat, and attorney who served as Deputy Attorney General of the United States and then Attorney General in the administration of Dwight D. Eisenhower. A member of the Republican Party, he served as U.S. Secretary of State in the administration of Richard Nixon.
